action.command: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); const path = require('path'); const filePath = process.env.KIRO_POST_FILE_CREATE_PATH || ''; if (filePath && filePath.includes('99-Templates')) { const versionFile = path.join(path.dirname(filePath), 'VERSION.txt'); fs.writeFileSync(versionFile, 'v1.0.0 - ' + new Date().toISOString() + '\n', { flag: 'a' }); console.log('Template version logged: ' + filePath); }"
